title: Sarin's Skull
summary: Return the skull to Sarin’s skeleton to earn Chancer’s Carcanet.

fields.Use: Combine the skull with the headless skeleton in Aelis’s lair. This does not turn Aelis hostile.
fields.Acquisition: In a pouch behind Bareki in Undercity Ruins at X −156, Y 946.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
